description.zh: Microsoft Copilot是集成到Microsoft 365和Windows中的AI助手，提供智能办公和生产力支持。
description.en: AI assistant integrated across Microsoft 365 and Windows, providing intelligent office automation and productivity support

description.zh: DataRobot 是企业级 AI 平台，把机器学习的建模、部署、监控与治理做成一站式流程：数据团队把表格数据接入后，平台自动尝试多种算法并选出最优模型，还持续监控线上模型的漂移与健康度。
description.en: DataRobot is an enterprise AI platform that covers modeling, deployment, monitoring and governance in one workflow: feed it tabular data and it automatically tries many algorithms and selects the best model, then keeps watching production models for drift and health issues.

description.zh: H2O.ai 是企业级 AI 平台厂商，其开源机器学习框架 H2O 被数据科学团队广泛用于建模；商业产品包括自动机器学习平台 Driverless AI、企业级大模型与文档智能方案，主打在企业内网与私有环境中安全地训练、部署与治理模型。
description.en: H2O.ai is an enterprise AI platform company. Its open-source H2O framework is widely used by data science teams for modeling, while its commercial products include the Driverless AI autoML platform and enterprise LLM and document AI offerings, built to train, deploy and govern models safely inside private environments.

description.zh: Coursera Coach 是在线课程平台 Coursera 的 AI 学习助手，嵌在课程学习流程里：它能结合你正在学的那门课的内容答疑、总结要点、生成练习题自测，并按你的目标给出学习路径建议。
description.en: Coursera Coach is the AI learning assistant built into the Coursera platform. It answers questions using the content of the course you are taking, summarizes key points, generates practice questions, and suggests next steps on your learning path based on your goals.

description.zh: Khanmigo 是非营利教育平台 Khan Academy 的 AI 导师，基于它自有的课程体系设计：它不直接给答案，而是用提问引导学生自己想出解法；同时给教师提供备课、出题与学情分析工具，给家长提供陪学视角。
description.en: Khanmigo is the AI tutor from the nonprofit Khan Academy, designed around its own curriculum. It does not hand over answers; it asks questions that guide students to the solution themselves, while giving teachers lesson-planning, quiz-building and class-insight tools and parents a window into their child's learning.

description.zh: Duolingo Max 是语言学习应用 Duolingo 的最高档订阅，在常规课程之上加入由大模型驱动的互动练习：针对你的答案给出个性化讲解、与 AI 角色做情景对话练习，并提供视频通话式的口语陪练。
description.en: Duolingo Max is the top subscription tier of the language-learning app Duolingo. On top of the regular courses it adds LLM-powered interactive practice: personalized explanations of your answers, roleplay conversations with AI characters, and video-call style speaking practice.

description.zh: Socratic 是 Google 出的免费作业辅导应用：拍照或语音提出问题，它会把问题拆解成知识点，给出分步解释，并聚合来自优质教育来源的图文与视频讲解，覆盖数学、科学、文学等中小学与大学基础科目。
description.en: Socratic is Google's free homework-help app. Ask by photo or voice and it breaks the question down into concepts, gives step-by-step explanations, and gathers text and video lessons from quality education sources, covering math, science, literature and other school and introductory college subjects.

description.zh: Adobe Sensei是Adobe的AI和机器学习平台，为Creative Cloud应用提供智能功能和自动化工具。

description.zh: Photomath 是拍照解数学题的应用：对准题目拍照或手写输入，就能得到分步的解题过程，覆盖小学算术到微积分的常见题型。它的重点不是只给答案，而是把每一步的原理讲清楚。
description.en: Photomath is a math-solving app: point the camera at a problem or write it by hand and it returns a step-by-step solution, covering everything from elementary arithmetic to calculus. Its point is not just the answer, but explaining the reasoning behind each step.

description.en: Replicate is a cloud platform for running AI models behind a single API. Instead of buying GPUs and setting up environments, developers pay for the hardware time a model actually uses to call image, video, audio and language models, and can also deploy and fine-tune their own.

description.zh: Hugging Face 是全球最大的开源 AI 协作平台，汇集了大量开源模型、数据集与可运行的演示应用（Spaces）。开发者可以直接下载或在线调用文本、图像、语音等各类模型，也能把自己的模型托管上去与社区共享；其 Transformers 等开源库已成为行业事实标准之一。
description.en: Hugging Face is the world's largest open AI collaboration platform, hosting a vast collection of open models, datasets and runnable demo apps (Spaces). Developers can download or call models for text, image and audio tasks, publish their own for the community, and build on libraries such as Transformers, which have become an industry standard.

description.en: Minimal avatar generation tool, enter any text to generate unique personalized avatars. Supports 12 style choices, PNG/JPG/SVG multi-format downloads, bilingual Chinese-English interface.

description.zh: 经典数字消除游戏，通过合并相同数字达到2048
description.en: Classic number merging game, combine same numbers to reach 2048

description.zh: 快速计算和理解复杂的中文亲戚关系称谓

description.zh: 通过科学的方法和持续的练习，帮助您养成良好习惯，改善生活质量

description.zh: 快速提取Notion页面URL中的Page ID，支持多种URL格式
description.en: Quickly extract Page ID from Notion page URLs with multiple format support

description.zh: 查询IP地址的地理位置、ISP信息等详细信息，支持IPv4和IPv6地址查询

description.en: Professional PDF processing tool supporting page splitting and merging multiple PDFs

description.zh: 支持多种文件格式相互转换，包括文档、表格、演示文稿等，完全在浏览器中处理，保护您的隐私
description.en: Convert between various file formats including documents, spreadsheets, presentations with browser-based privacy protection

description.zh: 一个直观的颜色选择工具，支持RGB、HSL等多种颜色格式
description.en: Intuitive color picker tool supporting RGB, HSL and various color formats

description.zh: 创建和管理多个倒计时，支持自定义时间、预设模板和提醒功能

description.zh: 一个强大的文字统计工具，实时显示文本的各种统计信息

description.en: Enhanced URL encoding/decoding tool with URL, Base64, HTML entity encoding, batch processing, history and advanced features

description.zh: 专业番茄工作法计时器，支持多主题、统计功能、桌面通知、自定义时长，提升专注力和工作效率

description.en: Modern AA accounting management system supporting personal bookkeeping and team splitting with smart algorithms, data visualization, and theme switching

description.zh: 中华诗词学习和测试系统，包含丰富的古诗词库，支持背诵练习、诗词赏析、知识测试
description.en: Chinese poetry learning and testing system with rich ancient poetry collection, recitation practice, poetry appreciation, and knowledge testing

description.zh: 专业的小红书营销海报制作工具，支持多种模板、自定义设计，快速生成吸引眼球的社交媒体内容
description.en: Professional Xiaohongshu marketing poster generator with multiple templates, custom design for creating attractive social media content

description.zh: 专业版网络连通性检测工具，实时监测多个海外服务状态，支持延迟测试、状态历史记录
description.en: Professional network connectivity checker with real-time monitoring of overseas services, latency testing, and status history

description.zh: 智能汇率转换器专业版，支持实时汇率、历史汇率查询、汇率走势图表、多货币计算
description.en: Smart currency converter Pro with real-time rates, historical rate queries, trend charts, and multi-currency calculations

description.zh: 基于 Gemini AI 的智能图片对比分析工具，深度分析技术参数和美学质量，提供专业的图像评估报告。
description.en: Intelligent image comparison tool powered by Gemini AI for technical and aesthetic analysis with professional evaluation reports.

description.zh: AI 驱动的智能证件照生成工具，一键将自拍转换为符合规范的专业证件照，自动处理背景和服装。
description.en: AI-powered ID photo generator that transforms selfies into compliant professional ID photos with automatic background and clothing adjustment.

description.zh: 现代化的 HTML/CSS/JS 在线代码编辑器和运行环境，支持 AI 辅助编码、实时预览、代码格式化和智能提示。
description.en: Modern HTML/CSS/JS online code editor and runtime with AI-assisted coding, live preview, code formatting, and intelligent suggestions.

description.zh: 把 API 返回的 JSON、b64_json 或 data:image/...;base64 一键还原成可见图片，并下载为 PNG。
description.en: Restore images from JSON responses, b64_json fields, or data:image/...;base64 strings and export them as PNG.

description.zh: 批量管理 Outlook 等邮箱账号，支持快速登录、2FA、验证码链接、状态/等级组合筛选、批量改状态/等级、含图 Excel 导出和完整备份。
description.en: Batch manage Outlook-style email accounts with quick login, 2FA, SMS links, combined status/plan filters, bulk status/plan updates, image Excel export, and full backups.

description.zh: 上传图片自动转换为拼豆像素图，支持多种网格尺寸和自定义颜色数量，附带颜色清单和用量统计，一键下载图案。
description.en: Convert any image to a perler beads pixel art pattern with customizable grid sizes and color counts. Includes BOM and one-click download.

description.zh: 足部骨折、崴脚、韧带损伤的每日康复记录 Dashboard。记录疼痛肿胀、负重训练，自动分析趋势并给出次日建议，数据仅存本地。
description.en: Daily rehab dashboard for foot fractures, sprains, and ligament injuries. Track pain, swelling, and training with local-only data and trend insights.

description.zh: 字节跳动推出的中文 AI 助手，适合日常问答、写作和多模态交流。
description.en: ByteDance's Chinese AI assistant for everyday questions, writing and multimodal conversations.

description.zh: 在 ChatGPT 中通过自然语言生成和编辑图片，适合快速构思与视觉创作。
description.en: Generate and edit images with natural language in ChatGPT for rapid ideation and visual creation.

description.zh: Grok 内置的图像生成能力，用文字提示快速创建和探索视觉创意。
description.en: Grok's built-in image generation experience for quickly exploring visual ideas from prompts.

description.zh: OpenAI 的编程智能体，可在真实代码仓库中理解需求、编写代码、运行命令并协助交付。
description.en: OpenAI's coding agent for understanding repositories, writing code, running commands and helping ship software.

description.zh: Anthropic 的终端编程智能体，可理解代码库并协助开发、调试和重构。
description.en: Anthropic's terminal coding agent for understanding codebases, development, debugging and refactoring.

description.en: An AI creation platform from CapCut/Jianying for generating images and videos with Chinese prompts.

description.zh: 快手推出的 AI 视频与图像创作平台，适合生成高质量动态画面。
description.en: Kuaishou's AI video and image creation platform for producing high-quality motion visuals.

description.zh: 网易推出的 AI 音乐创作工具，可辅助作词、作曲和歌曲生成。
description.en: NetEase's AI music creation tool for lyrics, composition and song generation.

description.zh: Gemini 的深度研究功能，可规划检索、综合多个来源并生成结构化研究报告。
description.en: Gemini's research mode for planning searches, synthesizing sources and producing structured reports.

description.zh: 网页双语对照翻译工具，支持网站、PDF、视频字幕等多种内容。
description.en: A bilingual translation tool for websites, PDFs, video subtitles and other content.

description.zh: GitHub 是全球最大的代码托管与协作平台，基于 Git 做版本管理，围绕仓库提供代码评审（Pull Request）、问题跟踪（Issues）、自动化流水线（Actions）与包管理等完整的研发协作能力；其 AI 编程助手 Copilot 也集成在平台与主流编辑器中。
description.en: GitHub is the world's largest code hosting and collaboration platform. Built on Git, it wraps repositories with pull-request code review, issue tracking, CI/CD automation (Actions) and package management, and its Copilot AI assistant is integrated into the platform and major editors.

description.zh: Cloudflare 是全球边缘网络与安全平台，最初以 CDN 加速与 DDoS 防护闻名，如今还提供域名注册、DNS 解析、Workers 无服务器计算、R2 对象存储与 Zero Trust 安全接入，开发者可以把网站、API 与应用部署到它的全球边缘网络上。
description.en: Cloudflare is a global edge network and security platform. Known first for CDN acceleration and DDoS protection, it now also offers domain registration, DNS, serverless compute with Workers, R2 object storage and Zero Trust access, so websites, APIs and apps can run on its edge network worldwide.

description.zh: Vercel 是面向前端与全栈应用的部署平台，也是 Next.js 的出品方。它把 Git 仓库与自动部署打通：每次推送自动构建上线，每个 Pull Request 自动生成独立预览地址，并自带全球边缘分发、函数计算与运行分析。
description.en: Vercel is a deployment platform for frontend and full-stack apps, and the company behind Next.js. It connects Git repositories to automatic deployments: every push builds and ships, every pull request gets its own preview URL, and global edge delivery, functions and analytics are built in.

description.zh: macOS 效率启动器，可通过快捷命令、扩展和 AI 加速日常工作流。
description.en: A macOS productivity launcher that speeds up workflows with commands, extensions and AI.

description.zh: 以本地 Markdown 为核心的知识管理工具，适合构建个人笔记与双向链接知识库。
description.en: A local-first Markdown knowledge tool for personal notes and linked knowledge bases.

description.zh: 以记忆和主动协助为核心的个人 AI 助手，用于整理上下文并推进日常任务。
description.en: A personal AI assistant centered on memory and proactive help for organizing context and moving work forward.

description.zh: 支持2-36进制转换、浮点数、自动识别与智能提示，高级模式包含度量衡、数据存储、时间日期等 7 大类转换，移动端友好，纯本地运行。
description.en: Convert numbers across bases 2-36 with floating-point support, auto-detection, and 7 advanced conversion categories. Runs fully offline and locally.

description.zh: 本地运行的快递管理系统，支持寄件收件登记、单号自动识别、OCR 图片识别、批量操作、CSV 导入导出与数据分析，数据仅存浏览器。
description.en: Local-first express package manager with auto tracking-number detection, OCR import, batch operations, CSV import/export, and analytics. Data stays in your browser.

description.zh: Muse 邀请码池：有码的人分享邀请码赚邀请奖励，没码的人免费匿名登录、随机领一个还有剩余次数的码。每个码按 Muse 显示的剩余次数精确发放，用完立即停发。
description.en: A pool of Muse invite codes: share yours to earn referral tokens, or sign in free (no email) and get a random code that still has uses left. Each code is handed out only up to the uses Muse shows, and stops the moment it runs out.

description.zh: Krea 的 AI 视频生成器支持通过文字或图片创建视频，并在同一工作区比较、延长和组合不同模型生成的结果。
description.en: Krea's AI video generator creates videos from text or images and lets creators compare, extend and combine results from multiple models in one workspace.

description.zh: AI 照片转 3D 工具：上传一张照片，自动生成带纹理、可直接 3D 打印的 STL 模型，无需建模经验。适合创客、3D 打印爱好者、手办/礼品定制与游戏素材。免费在线试用，高级功能订阅。
description.en: AI photo-to-3D tool: upload a photo and automatically generate a textured, 3D-printable STL model with no modeling experience needed. Great for makers, 3D printing hobbyists, figurine and gift customization, and game assets. Free online trial with advanced features via subscription.

description.zh: 电商卖家和数字广告主可以通过照片或文字提示生成视频广告和产品视觉图。支持图生视频、文生视频、多种 AI 生成模型和多种画幅比例，满足多样化的营销规格需求，帮助卖家为促销活动制作定制素材。按积分扣费，提供试用额度。
description.en: Ecommerce store owners and digital advertisers can generate video ads and product visuals from photos or text prompts using AIProductAds. With image-to-video and text-to-video features, multiple AI generation models, and various aspect ratios, the tool accommodates diverse marketing specifications. This helps sellers produce tailored assets for promotional campaigns. The software runs on credit-based plans, with trial credits offered when enabled.

description.zh: 在线 AI 照片清理工具，可直接在浏览器中去除照片里多余的物体、人物、水印和文字，无需安装软件。上传照片，涂抹想要去掉的部分，AI 会自然填充背景。
description.en: AI Image Cleaner is an online AI photo cleanup tool that removes unwanted objects, people, watermarks, and text from images in your browser—no software install required. Upload a photo, brush over what you want gone, and let AI fill the background naturally.

description.zh: AI ASMR 视频生成工具，用文字提示或上传图片即可生成放松助眠的视频。内置专门的 ASMR 工作区、环境音和约 50 个现成模板（雨声、海浪、篝火、轻语、敲击等），支持 Veo 3.1、Seedance 等多个模型，可调画面比例、分辨率和时长，适合 ASMR 创作者、助眠频道和短视频内容制作。
description.en: AIForASMR is an AI ASMR video generation tool that creates relaxing, sleep-friendly videos from text prompts or uploaded images. It features a dedicated ASMR workspace with ambient sounds and about 50 ready-made templates (rain, ocean waves, campfire, whispers, tapping and more), supports multiple models including Veo 3.1 and Seedance, and lets you adjust aspect ratio, resolution and duration - built for ASMR creators, sleep channels and short-form video content.

description.zh: FontKind AI 主打通过用户上传的照片，高质量还原个人笔迹，制作可安装、可重复使用的专属字体。同时支持根据文字描述和风格参考图生成字体，可预览自己的文字并下载 TTF 文件，覆盖 95 个 ASCII 字符。字体默认私有并支持商用。Pro 订阅每月 20 美元，Max 每月 200 美元。
description.en: FontKind AI recreates personal handwriting as a high-quality font from uploaded photos. It also generates fonts from text descriptions and style reference images, with previews and downloadable TTF files covering 95 ASCII characters. Fonts are private by default and support commercial use. Paid plans start at $20/month.

description.zh: ClipTalk 可将一句提示、一段脚本或一个产品页面变成可直接发布到 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts 的成品短视频：自动撰写脚本、生成 AI 画面、添加配音、字幕和音乐，并渲染为 MP4。模板涵盖 UGC 广告、无露脸故事、讲解视频、问答测验和音乐视频，可在时间线中编辑或直接用文字提出修改。也可通过 MCP 服务器（https://www.cliptalk.pro/mcp）在 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Cursor 中使用。注册即送免费积分，付费方案每月 19 美元起。
description.en: ClipTalk turns a prompt, script or product page into a finished short video for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts: script, AI visuals, voiceover, captions and music, rendered as an MP4. Templates cover UGC ads, faceless stories, explainers, quizzes and music videos, and edits can be made in a timeline or by asking. It also works inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor through its MCP server (https://www.cliptalk.pro/mcp). Free credits on signup.

description.zh: 免费的AI训练工作招聘网站：汇总约60个平台上的AI训练师、评估员、数据标注员和领域专家的在线职位，并显示每个职位公布的时薪。每天从25个平台自己的职位数据源更新（2026年10月约有3,400个开放职位），涵盖RLHF与评估、编程、数学、法律、医学和金融专家工作、语音与音频、数据标注以及多语言职位。免费使用，浏览无需注册。
description.en: A free job board for AI training work: live openings for AI trainers, evaluators, data annotators and domain experts across about 60 platforms, with the pay each advertises. Openings are pulled daily from 25 platforms' own job feeds (about 3,400 open roles in October 2026) and cover RLHF and evaluation, coding, math, law, medicine and finance expert work, voice and audio, data annotation and multilingual roles. Free, no signup needed.

description.zh: Imgkits 是一站式在线 AI 图片与视频编辑平台，2021 年上线。可去除多余物体和水印、修复老照片、替换背景、增强画质并应用创意滤镜，适合创作者在浏览器中快速处理图片。有免费试用，另有按量付费和 Pro 订阅。
description.en: Imgkits is an all-in-one online AI image and video editor, operating since 2021. It removes unwanted objects and watermarks, restores old photos, replaces backgrounds, enhances image quality and applies creative effects, all in the browser. Free trial available, with pay-as-you-go and Pro plans.

description.zh: TransMonkey 是 AI 翻译平台，支持文档、图片和视频翻译，覆盖 130 多种语言，可处理 PDF、PPT 等复杂格式并尽量保留排版，另有 Chrome 扩展。新用户有免费试用额度，之后按量付费或订阅。
description.en: TransMonkey translates documents, images, and videos with AI across 130+ languages, supporting complex formats like PDF and PPT while preserving the structure of translated files. A Chrome extension is also available. New users get free trial credits, then pay-as-you-go or subscription.

description.zh: Doc2X 是 NoEdgeAI 推出的 AI 文档处理工具，能把 PDF、扫描件和图片解析为可编辑的 Word、Markdown、LaTeX，准确识别数学公式与表格；支持 PDF 与 Word 双语对照翻译、AI 校对和试题整理，另有 Zotero 插件、桌面端与浏览器插件和按页计费的开发者 API。免费档每月可领取 150 页解析额度，另有每天 8 页免费额度。
description.en: Doc2X by NoEdgeAI converts PDFs, scans, and images into editable Word, Markdown, and LaTeX, with accurate recognition of math formulas and tables. It offers bilingual side-by-side translation for PDF and Word documents, AI proofreading, and exam-question organization, plus a Zotero plugin, desktop and browser apps, and a pay-per-page developer API. The free tier includes 150 claimable parsing pages per month plus a small daily free quota.

description.zh: MangaTranslate 是 Ficory LLC 的在线漫画翻译工具：上传漫画图片、PDF 或压缩包后自动 OCR 识别气泡文字、翻译并按原版式重新排字，支持批量处理和在线编辑器改稿、挪字框、换字体。目标语言 100 多种，翻译模型可选 GPT、DeepSeek、Grok 等。免登录每天有 5 个免费积分（约 2 到 5 页），注册签到可再领，付费有订阅与一次性积分包两种。
description.en: MangaTranslate, by Ficory LLC, translates manga pages online: upload images, PDFs or archives and it OCRs the speech bubbles, translates them and re-typesets the page in its original layout, with batch processing and an online editor to fix dialogue, move text boxes and change fonts. It targets 100+ languages with a choice of translation models (GPT, DeepSeek, Grok and more). No sign-in is needed for 5 free credits a day (about 2-5 pages), with more via daily check-in, and paid subscriptions or one-time credit packs.

description.zh: iMini AI 是 Nexus Line Limited 运营的一站式多模型 AI 创作平台：文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频同在一个工作区，聚合 Seedance 2.5、Nano Banana 2 与 Pro、GPT Image 2、Kling 3.0、Wan 2.7 等模型，另有创作智能体、模板库和无限画布。免费档每天有 1 次 Nano Banana 免费生成和 20 次对话；积分只随会员发放（Pro 每月 10000、Max 每月 30000、Ultra 每月 100000），月度积分不结转。
description.en: iMini AI, run by Nexus Line Limited, is an all-in-one multi-model AI creation platform: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video and image-to-video in one workspace, aggregating models such as Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana 2 and Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0 and Wan 2.7, plus a creation agent, a template library and an infinite canvas. The free plan includes one free Nano Banana generation and 20 chat conversations a day; credits come only with membership (Pro 10,000 a month, Max 30,000, Ultra 100,000) and unused monthly credits do not roll over.

description.zh: Online Vocal Remover 是 LearningLogic LLC 运营的在线人声分离工具：在浏览器里上传 MP3、WAV、M4A 或 OGG 文件（最大 50 MB），AI 把人声与伴奏拆成两条音轨，在线试听后可下载为 MP3 或 WAV。访客免登录可免费跑一次完整分离并试听，下载需登录；新账号送 20 积分，处理按每开始的 5 分钟一段扣 5 积分（访客单文件上限 5 分钟、登录用户 10 分钟），付费订阅与一次性积分包另含批量处理。
description.en: Online Vocal Remover, run by LearningLogic LLC, separates vocals from music in the browser: upload an MP3, WAV, M4A or OGG file (up to 50 MB) and it splits the track into vocal and instrumental stems you can preview online and download as MP3 or WAV. Guests can run one full separation and preview it free; downloading requires sign-in. New accounts receive 20 credits, processing costs 5 credits per started 5-minute block (one file up to 5 minutes for guests, 10 minutes when signed in), and paid subscriptions or one-time credit packs add batch processing.

description.zh: Novastart 是一个无限画布白板操作系统，把应用、共享画布和 AI 智能体汇集到同一个可视化工作区里。它用 Rust 构建，帮助个人和团队跳出传统窗口布局来组织工具、开展协作。免费档包含 1 个文件夹、2 个画布、每画布 4 个窗口；Pro 为每月 10 美元、画布不限量，Team 为每人每月 20 美元，AI 智能体按次另外计费。运营方为 Marketplace Distributors LLC，总部位于洛杉矶，2025 年 1 月创立。
description.en: Novastart is an infinite-canvas whiteboard OS that brings apps, shared canvases and AI agents together on one visual workspace. Built with Rust, it helps individuals and teams organize tools and collaborate beyond traditional window layouts. The free plan covers 1 folder, 2 canvases and 4 windows per canvas; Pro is $10/month for unlimited canvases, Team is $20/month per user, and AI agents are billed per use. It is run by Marketplace Distributors LLC, based in Los Angeles, and was founded in January 2025.

description.zh: easi.run 是一款免费开源软件（AGPL-3.0），通过 MCP 和 REST API 给接入的 AI 智能体提供一个自托管的 Chrome 浏览器，支持实时查看、人工接管、加密配置文件、隔离会话、文件传输和录制，推理则由接入的智能体完成。它运行在你自己的 Linux x86-64 服务器上，需要 systemd 和 rootful Docker；智能体和模型需自备，基础设施与模型费用另计。作者为 Juliano Gouveia。
description.en: easi.run is free, open-source software (AGPL-3.0) that gives connected AI agents a self-hosted Chrome browser via MCP and REST APIs, with live viewing, human takeover, encrypted profiles, isolated sessions, file transfers and recordings — the connected agent provides the reasoning. It runs on your own Linux x86-64 server with systemd and rootful Docker; you bring your own agent and model, and infrastructure and model costs are separate. Created by Juliano Gouveia.

description.zh: ViNano AI 在浏览器里用自然语言提示词和参考图创建、编辑图片并生成视频，内置 Veo 3.1、Seedance 等模型，还提供供智能体工作流调用的 MCP 服务器。每日签到和欢迎活动可领免费积分；订阅（Pro 每月 9.90 美元、Team 每月 29.90 美元）和一次性积分包可增加生成量，一次性积分永不过期。
description.en: ViNano AI creates and edits images and generates videos in the browser from natural-language prompts and reference images, with models such as Veo 3.1 and Seedance built in and an MCP server for agent workflows. Free credits are available through daily check-ins and welcome offers; subscriptions (Pro $9.90/month, Team $29.90/month) and one-time credit packs add more generations, and one-time credits never expire.

description.zh: BrewPage 用来发布和托管 HTML 页面、静态站点和 AI 产物，也能把 Markdown、文档、报告等任意文件通过 HTTPS 链接分享出去。它完全免费、无需注册：在编辑器里粘贴即可发布，也可以用一次 API 调用完成。为 AI 智能体（Claude、Codex、Gemini、Cursor）提供带 25 个工具的 MCP 服务器、llms.txt 和 OpenAPI 契约，另有 JSON 与键值托管。它是临时托管而非永久存储：页面默认 15 至 30 天到期（视发布方式而定），可选的免费 profile 最长可保留到 90 天。由 Maksim Kochetkov 以非商业社区项目形式维护。
description.en: BrewPage publishes and hosts HTML pages, static sites and AI artifacts, and shares Markdown, documents, reports and other files through HTTPS links. It is free and needs no signup: paste into the editor or publish with one API call. For AI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor) it offers an MCP server with 25 tools, llms.txt and an OpenAPI contract, plus JSON and key-value hosting. Hosting is temporary rather than permanent storage: pages expire after 15–30 days by default depending on how they are published, and an optional free profile extends retention to 90 days. It is run as a non-commercial community project by Maksim Kochetkov.

description.zh: ScribeAny 是免费的在线 AI 转录工具：上传 MP3、WAV、MP4 等音视频文件（单个上限 100 MB），或粘贴 YouTube、TikTok 等公开视频链接，即可得到带时间戳、可搜索可编辑的转录文本，还可翻译、生成摘要与要点，并导出 TXT、DOCX、PDF、SRT、VTT、CSV。无需注册。由新加坡 Deep Explore Pte. Ltd. 运营。
description.en: ScribeAny turns audio, video, and public video links into editable transcripts, translations, summaries, and subtitles. Free, no signup.

description.zh: 与 AI 相关的成本计算器：LLM API 成本、提示缓存节省、AI ROI、显存、RAG token 预算、AI 视频成本等，全部在浏览器本地计算。
description.en: AI-related cost calculators (LLM API cost, prompt caching savings, AI ROI, VRAM, RAG token budget, AI video cost, etc.)

description.zh: AI 图像与视频创作平台，把 GPT Image 2.5、Midjourney V8.2、Nano Banana 2、Seedance、Kling 等模型聚合到一个工作台，支持文生图、图生图编辑与图生视频；积分包按量付费、无订阅、积分永不过期，注册送 100 免费积分。
description.en: An AI image and video creation platform that brings GPT Image 2.5, Midjourney V8.2, Nano Banana 2, Seedance, Kling and more into one workspace for text-to-image, image-to-image editing and image-to-video generation. Pay-as-you-go credit packs with no subscription; credits never expire and new accounts get 100 free credits.

description.zh: OpenImmersive Translator 是一款开源（AGPL-3.0）的浏览器扩展，可将网页每段原文与译文对照显示，支持 199 种语言。免费引擎无需账号，也可自带 DeepL、OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥。官网还提供保留排版的 PDF 翻译，以及 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 文件、图片和漫画翻译。
description.en: OpenImmersive Translator is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) browser extension that shows each paragraph of a web page with its translation, in 199 languages. Its free engines need no account, or you can bring your own DeepL, OpenAI or DeepSeek key. The website also translates PDFs with the layout kept, plus Word, PowerPoint and Excel files, images and manga.
